subject.title: sandbox: keep workspaceAccess none workspaces writable

question: Should maintainers sponsor the narrow isolated-writable `workspaceAccess: "none"` fix now, or fold it into broader sandbox writable-bind policy work?
rationale: The intended direction is now clearer from maintainer discussion, but the repair changes sandbox-local write authorization and needs explicit owner/security review before implementation.

options.title: Sponsor Narrow Isolated-Writable Fix
options.body: Update only sandbox-owned `/workspace` writability for `none`, keep the real agent workspace unmounted, and leave custom host-bind writes to the separate open issue.

options.title: Fold Into Writable-Bind Policy
options.body: Delay this fix until the broader writable custom-bind policy defines one mount-aware write contract for `workspaceAccess: "none"`.

options.title: Keep Read-Only None
options.body: Keep current behavior and update docs/support guidance, which would supersede the maintainer comment that redirected work back to this issue.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Narrow Isolated-Writable Fix
recommendation.body: Update only sandbox-owned `/workspace` writability for `none`, keep the real agent workspace unmounted, and leave custom host-bind writes to the separate open issue.

likelyOwner.reason: They provided the latest explicit maintainer direction and have central sandbox plumbing history.
